###
usage: tpp session [-h] [--json]
                   {list,close,focus,kill,move,rename,reload-settings} ...

Manage TermuxPP terminal sessions.

positional arguments:
  {list,close,focus,kill,move,rename,reload-settings}
    list                list sessions and their IDs
    close               hang up a shell or dismiss an exited tab
    focus               switch to a session
    kill                force-kill a session shell
    move                move a session to a one-based position
    rename              change the session name
    reload-settings     reload app properties and styling

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                output JSON

Every command accepts --json, also in front of the command (tpp --json session
...). list prints the sessions as a JSON array. The other commands print a
JSON object that names the action and its arguments, for example {"ok": true,
"action": "close", "id": "ID"}. Failures print a message on standard error
and exit with a non-zero status, with or without --json.
### list
usage: tpp session list [-h] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      output JSON
### close
usage: tpp session close [-h] [--json] id

positional arguments:
  id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      output JSON
### focus
usage: tpp session focus [-h] [--json] id

positional arguments:
  id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      output JSON
### kill
usage: tpp session kill [-h] [--json] id

positional arguments:
  id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      output JSON
### move
usage: tpp session move [-h] [--json] id position

positional arguments:
  id
  position

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      output JSON
### rename
usage: tpp session rename [-h] [--json] id name

positional arguments:
  id
  name

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      output JSON
### reload-settings
usage: tpp session reload-settings [-h] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      output JSON
